newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia's February inflation 0.19 pct - official.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia's February inflation 0.19 pct - official.

text.p: Bolivia's consumer price index rose 0.19 percent in February, compared with a 2.76 percent rise in February 1996 and a 0.01 percent fall in January 1997, the National Statistics Institute said Tuesday.
In the 12 months to February inflation was 3.64 percent, the lowest in a decade, the institute said.
Bolivian inflation was 7.95 percent in 1996. The government forecasts inflation of 7.5 percent this year. ((--Carlos Quiroga, La Paz newsroom, 005912 391366))
